pca_directed_seed_sweep.partition_independence: All five runs share one fixed partition; varying model/experiment seed only.

independent_random_holdout.llm_train_r2_semantics: LLM formula training R2 only; NaN means unavailable/invalid and is not NN training R2.
independent_random_holdout.partition_independence: Five independent random partitions; model seed held fixed.

feature_ranking_diagnostic.pca_fit_scope: All 200 raw, unstandardized feature rows; descriptive and transductive

cutoff.qualitative_boundary_assessment: Displayed adjacent rows progress smoothly; no obvious discontinuity.

feature_ranking_diagnostic.interpretation: Every individual feature ranking exactly reproduces the PC1 ordering and the same 80-row training membership. For this dataset, the PCA split does not add a distinct multivariate ordering; the feature rows behave as a one-dimensional ordered trajectory for ranking purposes.

bootstrap_pca_sensitivity.interpretation: Distinct bootstrap samples yielded identical PC1 ranking and identical train/test membership. Negative tail R2 indicates poor tail prediction, not successful validation.

comparison_rules: Do not pool or average PCA far_r2 with random-holdout test_r2.
PCA results are five seed runs on one fixed transductive partition, not five independent partitions.
Random-holdout results measure interpolation/control, not PC1-directed far-range extrapolation.
Claims are limited to the selected Portfolio VaR case and tested configurations.
Feature-ranking diagnostic: each of the three individual feature rankings exactly reproduces the PCA PC1 ranking and train membership for this dataset.
Bootstrap PCA sensitivity result is negative (tail test R2 approximately -3.1518) and all five replicates shared one partition; do not describe it as successful validation.
The PCA conclusion remains provisional until the NN tail-error diagnostic is reviewed.
